pure-announcement.rationale: Reference documentation for existing builtin policies, not a launch, release note or funding post.

duplicate.rationale: Nothing in the corpus covers agent guardrail catalogs, thrashing/loop detection or no-write-down containment; the nearest concepts are MCP-governance and alerting notes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Each policy's behavior, parameters and defaults are specified concretely with runnable YAML examples checkable against the product.

durability.rationale: A per-product parameter matrix (handler paths, defaults, YAML shapes) that will churn with releases, even though embedded patterns like rolling-window thrashing detection and no-write-down containment age well.

actionability.rationale: Rich configuration guidance, but almost all of it is Omnigent-specific policy wiring; the transferable design rules (visibility before restriction, heuristic error windows) appear as asides inside product steps.

atomicity.rationale: A catalog of roughly 25 policies bundling several standalone-capable ideas — Bell-LaPadula no-write-down for agent file access, LLM-free thrashing detection via rolling error windows, identical-call loop detection, blast-radius command classification, graduated cost budgets — each of which could be its own concept.
